description: August 17 birthday meaning: Leo decan 3, birthday number 8, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, an August 17 birthday falls in Leo, in the third decan, with Sun as the sign's ruler and Mars as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 8. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Leo is fixed and fire.

sections.heading: Personality of an August 17 birthday
paragraphs: Late-summer strength defines the 17th of August. The Sun is twenty-four degrees into Leo, Mars sub-rules the decan, and 8 is numerology's number of authority. Traditional readings describe a commanding, resilient personality with a strong will and a protective streak. The softer skill to develop is flexibility, since determination this strong can tip into stubbornness.

By noon UTC on August 17, the Sun has normally reached roughly 24° of Leo. That places the date in the Leo decan that astrologers give to Mars, the third of three. The final third of Leo sits under Mars, ruler of Aries, and so mid-to-late August birthdays tend to carry the most forceful version of the sign. Courage, competitiveness and a readiness to defend people or principles are commonly associated with this decan. These Leos often lead from the front and prefer action to ceremony. Mars can make the temper quick and the pride prickly, especially when they feel challenged in public. The same fire gives them stamina for long campaigns. Channelling it into a cause bigger than personal recognition is often where this decan does its most memorable work.

sections.heading: Numerology of the August 17 birthday
paragraphs: Born on the 17th, you have the compound 1 + 7 = 8 as your birthday number. The 1 brings ambition and drive, the 7 brings analysis and inner reflection, and together they feed the 8's practical authority. People born on this day are often described as strategic and independent, with good judgement about money, systems and long-term plans. They tend to think before they act, then act decisively. Read as a secondary number, the 17 is traditionally associated with quiet confidence and with achievement that comes from combining a clear vision with patient attention to detail.

Because the year enters the Life Path calculation, the same August 17 birthday leads to different paths across generations, among them 7 for 1980, 8 for 1990, 9 for 2000 and 1 for 2010. Some birth years on this date reach the master numbers 11 and 22. The Life Path calculator does the reduction for any year.

sections.heading: August 17 in context: the season, Chinese zodiac and famous birthdays
paragraphs: An August birthday falls in late northern summer, a season of early harvests and holidays, and in late winter for the southern hemisphere, when the first blossom starts to appear. Leo holds most of the month, with Virgo arriving around August 22 or 23. August is month 8 in numerology, associated with ambition, authority and material skill, a fitting partner for Leo's confidence. August 17 is the 229th day of the year (230th in a leap year). In most years Virgo season is under way by August 23, 6 days after this birthday.

Chinese astrology is straightforward for an August 17 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies. August 17 is also the birthday of Robert De Niro (1943), Herta Müller (1953) and Mae West (1893).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is August 17?
faq.answer: August 17 is Leo in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the third decan of Leo, which tradition links with Mars.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on August 17?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On August 17 the Life Path is 5 in 1960, 6 in 1970, 7 in 1980, 8 in 1990, 9 in 2000, 1 in 2010 and 2 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 8 for everyone born on the 17th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on August 17?
faq.answer: By August 17 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on August 17?
faq.answer: Among the best-known people with an August 17 birthday are Robert De Niro (1943), Herta Müller (1953) and Mae West (1893). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
